**Dish:** Samosa
**Cuisine:** South Asian / Indian
**Ingredients (likely):** Wheat flour, potatoes, green peas, spices, oil (for frying)
**Estimated calories:** 260 kcal per medium samosa
**Macros (approx per serving):** Protein: 4g | Carbs: 30g | Fat: 14g
**Health notes:** Deep-fried snack high in carbohydrates and fats; contains gluten. Enjoy in moderation.

**Dish:** Chicken Tikka Masala
**Cuisine:** Indian / British-Indian
**Ingredients (likely):** Chicken chunks, tomatoes, cream, yogurt, onions, garlic, ginger, spices (garam masala, turmeric, cumin, coriander), cilantro
**Estimated calories:** 450-550 kcal
**Macros (approx per serving):** Protein: 35g | Carbs: 12g | Fat: 28g
**Health notes:** High in protein and rich in spices with antioxidant properties. Contains dairy (cream/yogurt) which is an allergen.

**Dish:** Chicken Biryani
**Cuisine:** Indian / South Asian
**Ingredients (likely):** Basmati rice, chicken (leg quarter/drumstick), yogurt, ghee or vegetable oil, fried onions, herbs (cilantro, mint), Indian spices (garlic, ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, turmeric, chili powder)
**Estimated calories:** 600 kcal
**Macros (approx per serving):** Protein: 35g | Carbs: 65g | Fat: 22g
**Health notes:** Excellent source of protein and energy-dense carbohydrates; may be high in saturated fats depending on the amount of ghee or oil used. Contains digestive spices like ginger and cardamom.

**Dish:** Chicken Biryani
**Cuisine:** Indian / South Asian
**Ingredients (likely):** Basmati rice, chicken, yogurt, onions, tomatoes, ghee or oil, ginger, garlic, spices (garam masala, turmeric, saffron, cardamom, cloves), cilantro, mint
**Estimated calories:** 650 kcal per serving
**Macros (approx per serving):** Protein: 35g | Carbs: 70g | Fat: 25g
**Health notes:** High in protein and aromatic spices with antioxidant properties; contains dairy (ghee/yogurt) and moderate to high fat content.

**Dish:** Dhokla
**Cuisine:** Indian (Gujarati)
**Ingredients (likely):** Chickpea flour (besan), semolina, yogurt, ginger, green chilies, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, coriander, chutneys
**Estimated calories:** 200-250 kcal for a serving of 3-4 pieces with chutney
**Macros (approx per serving):** Protein: 6g | Carbs: 30g | Fat: 7g
**Health notes:** Steamed and relatively low in fat, good source of vegetarian protein. Contains gram flour and dairy (yogurt).

**Dish:** Khaman Dhokla
**Cuisine:** Indian (Gujarati)
**Ingredients (likely):** Gram flour (besan), yogurt, lemon juice, ginger, mustard seeds, green chilies, cilantro, sugar, oil, water, chutneys (green and tamarind)
**Estimated calories:** 250 kcal
**Macros (approx per serving):** Protein: 8g | Carbs: 35g | Fat: 9g
**Health notes:** Relatively low in calories and fat, steamed rather than fried. Contains legume protein, but be cautious with added sugars in the chutneys.
